scope: UI/layout resource-chain audit from day-2 DIY through Island Designer unlock; excludes raw models/audio and code/runtime implementation.

status_legend.EXISTS: Index/archive record exists with source identity/hash where available.
status_legend.PSEUDO: Exact static getter string equals a layout ID, but no runtime load/action relationship is established.
status_legend.CANDIDATE: Semantic beat→layout association by name/page family; EventFlow/native runtime open path not proven.
status_legend.CONSUMER_JOINED: Exact structural relation in indexed data (BFLYT pane→material→texture→unique same-archive BNTX; font alias/resource; animation target; or unique prt1 part-layout reference). Does not prove draw or page runtime.
status_legend.OPEN: No exact link/consumer proof in current index.

evidence_method.page_method_binding: A native page method returning a layout identifier is only a static page→layout name association. No EventFlow action→page caller or executed render state is inferred from that alone.
evidence_method.bflit_chain: Pane names/material indices are read from BFLYT; material texture indices resolve against BFLYT textures; a texture is promoted to CONSUMER_JOINED only when it has exactly one same-archive BNTX candidate.
evidence_method.font_chain: BFLYT font reference→FontInfo alias→indexed FCPX/BFFNT resource member/hash. Locale selection remains separate.
evidence_method.animation_chain: BFLAN member/tag/track data with exact same-archive pane/material targets; page animation trigger remains OPEN.
evidence_method.shader_chain: Only named GLSL materials whose source member is uniquely indexed inside that layout archive are CONSUMER_JOINED; compiled BNSH is recorded separately without variant/draw proof.
evidence_method.effect_chain: Effect/PTCL banks and effect-link databases can be EXISTS in supplemental inventory; no association to UI layout or story effect trigger without an indexed link.

native_page_method_index.source_build: ACNH main.elf from the locally extracted game build; same RomFS/ExeFS corpus used by the static UI analysis

method.resolution: R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocation at address_point + 0x170 resolves to an AArch64 ADRP/ADD/RET getter; its returned NUL-terminated string is compared exactly to screen_catalog layout names.
method.interpretation: The code-pointer slot returns a string identical to a catalogued layout name. This is a static page-to-layout identifier crosswalk; the slot's semantic name, caller, loader handoff, runtime ownership, instantiation, and rendering are not established.

limits: The 135 pages are those matching the existing shared-factory scan, not a proof of every page in the game.
An exact returned string does not prove that a loader calls the method or that the page loads, owns, or renders that BFLYT.
No direct B/BL instruction targets any of the 135 getter functions; indirect calls are not associated with a page receiver by this static crosswalk.
A returned identifier absent from the available 523-layout catalog may resolve through another archive, version, alias, or no resource; this static corpus does not decide which.

native_page_registry_index.matching_rule: Remove the leading c from registry page names that have it, then compare exactly with factory class name minus the suffix Page; entries without c are compared as exact names.
native_page_registry_index.interpretation: Registry/factory candidates are name-normalization candidates only unless a separate caller/runtime route is established.

version_and_provenance_caveats.baseline_gameplay: Story/EventFlow references are from project B_data base package, documented as ACNH 1.0.0 in the existing crosswalk.
version_and_provenance_caveats.supplemental_layouts: The audited BFLYT archives come from the additional RomFS set. Its summary compares 25,597 files: 1,171 identical and 24,426 new_path; it explicitly says not to infer exact version from filenames. All selected Layout archive manifest states are recorded per layout.
version_and_provenance_caveats.hash_scope: BFLYT/member and layout-container SHA-256 values identify parsed sources. Resource inventory hashes identify BFLAN/GLSL/font/effect member bytes when available. This establishes identity, not build compatibility with baseline EventFlow.
version_and_provenance_caveats.external_index_path: Supplemental extracted manifest and resource inventory were read from /workspace/acnh-re/output/additional_romfs; these are referenced by hash and not copied.
